permissions.view: See the dashboards, projects, POs, payments, vendors, timeline, anomalies and reports, and export them
permissions.edit: Accept anomalies, set budgets, head owners, expected dates and PO aliases, save layouts and report templates
permissions.setup: Settings: data sources, offline workbook uploads, email alerts (sender, recipients, test send)

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Sees every dashboard and report and can export them. Changes nothing.

roles.name: Editor
roles.description: Everything a viewer can do, plus accept anomalies, set budgets, owners, expected dates and PO aliases, and save layouts and report templates.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: Everything an editor can do, plus Settings: data sources, workbook uploads and email alerts.
